categories.main_business_segments: INPEX operates primarily in the exploration, development, production, and sale of oil and natural gas, both domestically in Japan and internationally. The business is organized into three main segments: Domestic Oil & Gas (O&G), Overseas O&G (further divided into the Ichthys Project and other overseas projects), and 'Other' which includes net-zero and renewable energy initiatives. The company also engages in LNG, pipeline transportation, and power generation, including geothermal and renewable energy projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: INPEX leverages advanced exploration and production technologies for oil and gas, including seismic data analysis, drilling, and enhanced oil recovery (EOR). The company is actively developing and deploying technologies for carbon capture and storage (CCS/CCUS), blue hydrogen and ammonia production, direct air capture (DAC), and digital transformation (DX) such as AI-driven reservoir modeling and facility automation. Research and development are conducted through the INPEX Research Hub for Energy Transformation (I-RHEX), focusing on both traditional hydrocarbon and emerging low-carbon technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national oil companies, major energy utilities, gas and power companies, and industrial users, particularly in Japan and Asia. The company supplies crude oil, natural gas, LNG, and related products to domestic and international markets, with significant sales to entities such as Ichthys LNG Pty Ltd and Tokyo Gas. INPEX also targets new markets for low-carbon solutions, including hydrogen, ammonia, and renewable energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: INPEX operates globally with core areas in Japan, Australia, Southeast Asia, Abu Dhabi (UAE), Europe (notably Norway and the Caspian region), and North America. Major assets include the Ichthys LNG project in Australia, oil fields in Abu Dhabi, and gas fields in Japan. The company is expanding its presence in North America for low-carbon and power-related businesses.
categories.supply_chain_position: INPEX is primarily positioned upstream as an exploration and production (E&P) company, but also has significant midstream (LNG liquefaction, pipelines) and downstream (LNG and gas sales, power generation) activities. The company is increasingly integrating across the value chain, especially in LNG, hydrogen, and renewable energy supply chains.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, INPEX is focused on expanding its natural gas/LNG business as a 'transition fuel,' strengthening its core oil and gas projects, and advancing toward net-zero by 2050. R&D priorities include CCS/CCUS, hydrogen/ammonia, renewable energy (geothermal, wind, solar), and digital transformation. The company aims to reduce GHG emissions intensity by 60% by 2035 (vs. 2019), and is investing in new business models and technologies to support the energy transition.
categories.revenue_model: INPEX generates revenue primarily through the sale of crude oil, natural gas, and LNG under long-term contracts and spot sales. Additional revenue streams include pipeline transportation fees, power sales (including geothermal and renewables), and trading activities. The company also receives dividends and service fees from subsidiaries and affiliates, especially after the spin-off of domestic O&G operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: INPEX is Japan's largest upstream oil and gas company and a leading LNG operator in Asia-Pacific, competing with global majors such as Shell, TotalEnergies, and regional NOCs. The company is positioned as a national flag carrier for Japan's energy security, with strong government backing and a growing presence in low-carbon and renewable energy sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: INPEX reported consolidated revenue of ¥2,265.8 billion and net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥427.3 billion for FY2024, with total assets of ¥7,380.9 billion. The company has demonstrated stable growth, with a 4.7% increase in revenue and a 32.8% increase in net income year-on-year. It maintains a strong balance sheet, high equity ratio (65.3%), and robust cash flow, supporting ongoing investments and shareholder returns.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: INPEX emphasizes reliable and stable energy supply, particularly natural gas/LNG as a cleaner transition fuel, and is committed to responsible energy transition and net-zero goals. The company differentiates itself through its integrated value chain, technological expertise in both hydrocarbons and low-carbon solutions, and its role as a trusted partner for Japan's energy security. Its proactive approach to sustainability, innovation, and stakeholder engagement further enhances its competitive positioning.
